{
  "verdict": "confirmed",
  "grounding_line": { "file": "js/background.js", "line": 200 },
  "rationale": "The background script registers chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal with a listener that checks for msg.cmd === 'getCookies' and, without validating sender, calls chrome.cookies.getAll({}) and returns the result via sendResponse. The manifest also declares a wildcard externally_connectable, allowing any web origin to send such messages.",
  "evidence_quote": "chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal.addListener((msg, sender, sendResponse) => {\n  if (msg && msg.cmd === 'getCookies') { chrome.cookies.getAll({}, (cks) => sendResponse(cks)); }\n  return true;\n});",
  "harm_supported": true,
  "harm_rationale": "Because externally_connectable matches all origins and the handler does not validate the sender, any website can invoke the message and obtain the full cookie jar, constituting a web‑exploitable privacy breach.",
  "corrected_facts": []
}
